title: Live-Proven Compiler: grounded surfaces, fault isolation, one assessment identity

claims.summary: Course FAQ builders quote kernel facts, task descriptions, misconception-versus-correction, scenario materials, and term definitions (enrichmentSource-tagged); discussion follow-ups and response stems quote authored positions and tension; rubric parameter rows, syllabus week vocabulary, study-guide practice activities, and registry exam short answers ground in per-lesson atoms.

measureGroundedFraction counts enrichmentSource-ancestor bytes per deliverable; recordContentFallbackHit counts lens/modality/genre/protocol dictionary defaults; both surface as the groundingMetrics pipelineDecision event and grounding_metrics trace; the final live round reported overall ~43% (discussions 98%, assignments 99%).

The kernel schema gains a studyGuide block (summary sm 60-600 chars, reviewStrategy rs 30-400, meta-language lint) and a course-level discussionProtocol (format/participationPattern/artifactUse/reviewFocus, complete-or-dropped validation); compileStudyGuides prefers authored summaries and buildDiscussionProtocol prefers the complete authored protocol over the 34-genre dictionary, which fires a counted fallback instead.

compileBlueprintDeliverables wraps each feature in try/catch and reports failures on the Symbol.for('coursemapper.blueprintCompileErrors') channel so only the failed feature errors with its real message; compileBlueprintDeliverablesYielding yields between features on the browser path (was a 0.8-1s synchronous main-thread block); the compiler entry chunk is budgeted in checkBundleBudgets.

Live catch 1: courseIR and compileQuizBank fall back to the same classifyAssessmentKind title rule the export manifest uses (plus the exam-review-guide false-positive fix). Live catch 2: dedupeNumberedAssessmentEcho runs where registry rows are born (map derivation, Pass A skeleton parse, courseIR normalize) with a manifest belt for legacy saved graphs. Live catch 3: getCourseMapFallbackValue never rewrites an exam-bearing assessment cell and can never mint an exam-classified title.

Final crucible smoke round passed end-to-end: 99/A, 0 P0, in-app score identical to offline regrade (delta 0), $0.12, 165 seconds, 125-file ZIP — after three blocked rounds (74/C) whose causes were diagnosed and fixed during this release; cachedInputTokens 1280 observed live on courseIR calls; the crucible driver now dumps the autosaved project to project-at-failure-<phase>.json on any failure.

knownRemainingTargets: Kernel-authored modality modeDetails (mirror of the discussionProtocol pattern) and lesson-plan flat-mode step descriptions remain open roadmap items.
compactBlueprintForStorage on the hot compile path (state-size half of the off-main-thread item) is deferred to its own round due to persistence-shape risk.
Mechanical decomposition of the 21.5k-line compiler continues leaf-first (lessonContext extraction, per-deliverable compilers starting with courseFaq).
The final green live round showed cachedInputTokens 0 on its calls while three earlier rounds showed 1280 on courseIR — cache-hit consistency across providers/rounds is not yet claimed.
The raw-map facade path (headless-only legacy) still title-shortens at extraction; in-app maps go through derive-on-open and are unaffected.
